title: Software that manages your physical systems.
body: The hardware decides whether a door opens. Veranda's software decides who, when, and why, then keeps a record of everything that happened.

showcase.title: One window into the Veranda platform
showcase.body: The Dashboard app is one interface into Veranda's software. Check the status of deliveries, open or lock a device, set access schedules, or grant access to authorized people remotely. The same platform also serves operators managing many devices and the partner systems that feed it.

image.alt: Veranda Dashboard app on a phone

sdk.title: Build Veranda into your own software
sdk.body: The API and SDK libraries give your developers the same control the Dashboard has: lock and unlock devices, manage access, read sensor data, and subscribe to events as they happen. Connect Veranda to your dispatch, ordering, or property-management systems without building the hardware, wireless, or cloud layers yourself.

image.alt: Code editor showing the Veranda SDK unlocking a device, with the API response beside it

responsibilities.title: Hands-free access
responsibilities.body: Authorized users just need the app on their phone. Walk up, tap, and the box opens.

responsibilities.title: Shared & partner access
responsibilities.body: Friends and family get their own access. Partners get in only when a delivery needs it.

responsibilities.title: Scheduled access
responsibilities.body: Set one-time or repeating windows for the box to unlock, stay open, or lock again after use.

responsibilities.title: Device & sensor monitoring
responsibilities.body: Follow lock state, battery, connectivity, and live sensor readings across every device.

responsibilities.title: Activity & events
responsibilities.body: Look back at every open, close, and change in condition across your devices.

responsibilities.title: Status updates & alerts
responsibilities.body: Let the right people know when a delivery arrives, or when something looks unusual.
